unattributed_remainder.definition: Owner total wall minus recorded build, partition-controller and type-command walls. Includes other commands/archives/inventory/guards and bookkeeping gaps; no per-crate, linking-only or idle attribution.

source_guards.policy: Complete registered IR/AOT/runtime test types precede serial target-native verification. Each ELF receives an actual inventory, nonempty exact focus when required, and the complete inventory including ignored tests. Archive only the owned closed test ELF before the next link; keep all raw results, REDs and missing IDs. Actual producers come only from Cargo events. No CLI/product build, whole-workspace no-run or oracle feature. The completed current continuation remains immutable; all sixteen scopes and both type cohorts execute freshly. Its complete inventory, focus IDs, passes and REDs remain mandatory retained inputs. Exact focus and disjoint remaining IDs use separate raw native processes; process-global initialization, cache warming and order-dependent state can differ from one unfiltered full process. Optional warm cache handoff uses an exclusive closed-owner content/key admission contract. Build/native/storage failures remain scoped and later targets continue while source and immutable evidence guards hold. This affected-batch receipt is not a full pinned Test262 or full-workspace acceptance.
